'''Junter Galt''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Galt led the branch of the [[Citizens' Militia]] for the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] settlement [[Camp Karnori|Espelar]].

==Biography==
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], Junter Galt was a native of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He lived in [[Camp Karnori|Espelar]], a Republic settlement in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] region south of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]]. He worked as the leader of Espelar's branch of the [[Citizens' Militia]], the regional militia.<ref name="Training" />

But in [[3643 BBY]], the militia had suffered heavy losses. This sharply decreased the number of new recruits, leaving Galt with only a handful of new volunteers and no combat instructors. When a Republic-allied individual was sent by the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Galen Besk]] to stop Imperial [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteurs]] from destroying Espelar's trading posts after a sandstorm, the individual was asked by Galt and Mayor [[Airen]] to help train the new recruits.<ref name="Training" />

The individual led [[Vastil]] and other new volunteers against the native [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] for combat training,<ref name="Training" /> but Galt received a distress call from [[Cole Darba]] when they returned. Darba and his men were pinned down in [[Manister Base]], which had been overrun by a [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] hive. The individual led Vastil and the others into combat once again, rescuing the trapped militiamen from the base. In recognition of Vastil and his men's bravery, Galt fully inducted all of the new recruits into the militia.<ref name="Trial">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Militia's Trial|Tatooine}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Junter Galt was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. Galt gives Republic players on Tatooine the missions "Militia Training" and "Militia's Trial", as part of the Tatooine Bonus Series.<ref name="Trial" /> He is voiced by [[Norm Woodel]].
